title: [29.x]Adjustment Amount is not accurate in the Exch. Rate Adjmt. Ledger Entries page if an Unrealized Gain gest registered and a second adjustment turns into a Loss.
summary: The Exchange Rate Adjustment process now correctly calculates individual adjustment amounts in ledger entries when unrealized gains reverse into losses, instead of incorrectly using cumulative amounts.
key_points: Fixed calculation to use each detailed entry's own linked amount instead of accumulated total
Adjustment Amount now accurately reflects per-row values in Exchange Rate Adjustment Ledger Entries page
Addresses scenario where unrealized gain reverses and subsequent adjustment becomes a loss
Added comprehensive test coverage for the correction
